clue.text: Quiet for the victor ludorum.

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Quiet for the victor ludorum.' (5): only 'Quiet' defines PEACE; no wordplay for the rest gives the letters (P + ACE leaves an E unaccounted), so it looks cut short or misread, and a search found no fuller text.

clue.text: Common soldier about to retreat from man-of-war

parts.note: a private is a soldier of the lowest rank

indicators.note: retreating goes backwards, so the word for about is read in reverse

parts.note: re is Latin-derived for about or concerning

explanation.surface: A lowly soldier withdraws from a warship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to retreat' turns RE (about) into ER, which follows PRIVATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A privateer was an armed private vessel licensed to attack enemy shipping, a kind of warship.

clue.text: Made smart moves to acquire capital

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone made clever investments to raise funds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' rearranges MADE SMART; 'capital' looks like money but is a capital city, the Dutch one.
explanation.definitionFit: Amsterdam is the official capital city of the Netherlands.

clue.text: Flat in Little Venice

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of the words Little Venice

explanation.surface: An apartment in a smart London district by the canals.
explanation.walkthrough: Little Venice is a canal-side area of west London, which makes 'Flat' read as an apartment; it is the adjective meaning level.
explanation.definitionFit: Something level and smooth is described as even.

clue.text: Made conditions suitable for employment

explanation.surface: Someone set out terms fit for hiring staff.
explanation.definitionFit: To qualify a statement is to add conditions to it, and a qualified person has the training a job requires.

clue.text: Accommodation officer employs teacher on 25% time

parts.note: a quarter is a fourth part, as of an hour
a schoolmaster, or master, is a teacher

explanation.surface: An official in charge of housing takes on a part-time teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'employs' and 'on' are link words here. The officer is the army quartermaster, who sees to soldiers' quarters and supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A quartermaster is the military officer responsible for lodging and stores.

clue.text: I have to write up a letter in Greek

indicators.note: in a down entry, writing upwards reverses the word to

explanation.surface: I must compose a message in Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'write up' reverses TO to OT between I and A; 'have' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Picture one sorcerer

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
a mage is a magician or wizard

explanation.surface: A portrait of a single wizard.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a likeness or representation, such as a painting.

clue.text: Many study terror

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: Lots of reading causes fear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many' giving D (500) is a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is great fear or apprehension.

clue.text: Children matter

explanation.surface: Children are important.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring in legal language, and also a topic or subject under discussion.

clue.text: Bar attire ordered by judge

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Barristers' gowns prescribed by a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges BAR ATTIRE; 'judge' is a verb here, not the bench official.
explanation.definitionFit: To arbitrate is to settle a dispute as an impartial referee.

clue.text: Working again, but with spinal support

explanation.surface: Someone is back at work, wearing a back brace.
explanation.definitionFit: Back in harness is an idiom for returning to work, and read literally it is a harness strapped on the back.

clue.text: The third man is pronounced fit

indicators.note: says the word for fit is heard spoken

parts.note: able means capable or fit to do something

explanation.surface: A film villain is said to be in good shape.
explanation.walkthrough: The Third Man suggests the film, but in Genesis Abel was the third man born after Adam and Cain.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible Abel, son of Adam, was the third human named.

clue.text: Standing by a tree trunk

explanation.surface: Someone is waiting beside a tree trunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock means reputation or status, and also the main stem of a tree.

clue.text: Crazy about English drink

indicators.note: the word for crazy goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: mad means crazy

explanation.surface: Someone is wild about an English beverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts E inside MAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Mead is an alcoholic beverage made from fermented honey.

clue.text: Dwarf presents a spectacular display

explanation.surface: A small person puts on a big show.
explanation.definitionFit: To stunt growth is to check it, and a stunt is a daring feat to attract attention.

clue.text: Southern Confederate made an excursion

parts.note: an ally is a confederate or partner

explanation.surface: A Southern soldier from the Civil War went on a trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Confederate' suggests the American South, but it is just a partner; 'made' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a sudden sortie or a short trip out.

clue.text: Resolve to keep retired press chief close

indicators.note: going back, so the abbreviation for press chief is read backwards

parts.note: ED is short for editor, the chief at a newspaper
termination is an end or close

explanation.surface: A decision to keep a retired editor nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns ED into DE before TERMINATION; 'to keep' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Determination is firmness of purpose, as resolve is.

clue.text: Where players perform together

parts.note: players seem to be actors or athletes, but the phrase describes musicians playing jointly, and also figuratively acting as one

explanation.surface: A description of an ensemble venue.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means acting jointly, as musicians do at a performance.

clue.text: Not named? I? Weird, and quite untrue!

definitions.text: Not named? I? Weird, and quite untrue!

indicators.note: weird signals the letters are scrambled into strange new order

explanation.surface: Someone protests at being told they were not put forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Weird' rearranges NOT NAMED I; the result means named, so 'not named' is indeed quite untrue.
explanation.definitionFit: To be nominated is to be named or put forward as a candidate.

clue.text: Religionist yields to monarchical reform

indicators.note: the letters are reformed, put into a new shape

explanation.surface: A believer gives in to a change of royal rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reform' rearranges TO and MONARCHICAL; 'yields' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A Roman Catholic is a member of the Christian church headed by the Pope.

clue.text: Riotous rabble besetting a biblical kingdom

indicators.note: the word for the crowd surrounds the letter

parts.note: a mob is a disorderly crowd

explanation.surface: A rampaging crowd attacks an ancient realm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'besetting' puts A inside MOB.
explanation.definitionFit: Moab was an ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea named in the Old Testament.

clue.text: I object to son rejecting award

parts.note: me is the object form of I

indicators.note: rejecting turns back the word for son

parts.note: a lad is a boy or son

explanation.surface: A parent objects when a son turns down a prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I object' is grammar: ME is I as an object. 'rejecting' turns LAD into DAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A medal is a metal disc given as an honour.

clue.text: A large number turned up in India

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means the word for large number reads upward

parts.note: a mass is a great quantity

explanation.surface: Lots of people appeared in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses MASS to SSAM after A. The definition names a place found in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a state in north-east India, famous for tea.

clue.text: Utterly plain

explanation.surface: Completely simple.
explanation.definitionFit: Stark means completely, as in stark naked, and also bare or unadorned.

clue.text: Shortly indicated a negative response by the French

parts.note: non is French for no

explanation.surface: Someone soon signalled a French refusal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indicated' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is an old word meaning soon, in a little while.

clue.text: Impudent young woman about to strike

parts.note: C, for circa, means about
to hit is to strike

explanation.surface: A cheeky girl is about to lash out.
explanation.walkthrough: C is short for circa, Latin for about.
explanation.definitionFit: Chit is a dated disparaging word for a pert girl.

clue.text: Top-class deputy head gave unbeatable service

parts.note: ace means excellent

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A first-rate deputy head served brilliantly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deputy head' looks like a school post but gives D. The definition is tennis: an ace is a serve the opponent cannot touch.
explanation.definitionFit: To ace is to serve a winner in tennis that the receiver fails to return.

clue.text: Diana's accusation results in acquittal

parts.note: Di is short for Diana, with the possessive s
a charge is a formal accusation

explanation.surface: A woman's accusation ends with someone being cleared.
explanation.walkthrough: 'results in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A discharge is a release from custody or liability, as an acquittal is.

clue.text: Con man caught by Tom

indicators.note: the word for man is held inside the word for tom

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
he is a male pronoun

explanation.surface: A swindler is apprehended by a man called Tom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Con man' reads as one phrase, but 'Con' alone is the definition; 'caught by' puts HE inside CAT.
explanation.definitionFit: To con is to swindle or deceive.

clue.text: Never-ending plea to impose fewer restrictions

explanation.surface: An endless request to ease the rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Limitless means boundless, and split as limit less it urges fewer limits.

clue.text: Old hat Lawrence stored by father

indicators.note: the initials sit inside the word for father

parts.note: dad is father
T. E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia

explanation.surface: An old hat belonging to Lawrence kept by Dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stored by' puts TE inside DAD. T. E. Lawrence was the British officer known as Lawrence of Arabia.
explanation.definitionFit: Old hat means out of fashion, which is what dated means.
